items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: The first record date I made was with a piano player named J. C. Johnson

ctx.x: Were you making other records at that time? What was the first record date you remember being on?
The first record date I made was with a piano player named J. C. Johnson, James C. Johnson.
